findings.highlight: It’s eleven o’clock
findings.evidenceJa: 時刻は午後十時
findings.governingReading: the time is ten in the evening
findings.explanation: The patrol begins one hour later in English.

findings.highlight: careful not to wake Sakura
findings.evidenceJa: 桜に気付かれないよう外に出る
findings.governingReading: they go out without Sakura noticing
findings.explanation: Concealment from Sakura is narrowed into avoiding waking her, assuming sleep and changing the social purpose.

findings.highlight: to make up for yesterday
findings.evidenceJa: 昨夜の遅れを取り戻す為
findings.governingReading: to make up for last night’s delay
findings.explanation: The specific delay and nighttime interval disappear.

findings.highlight: The town has continued to suffer while my guard was down
findings.evidenceJa: 安心した油断をついて新たな被害が拡がった
findings.governingReading: new harm spread by exploiting the complacency that followed Caster’s defeat
findings.explanation: A newly expanding attack that exploits Shirou’s relief becomes generic continued suffering simultaneous with personal inattention.

findings.highlight: collecting energy from people
findings.evidenceJa: 今夜もその手を伸ばす
findings.governingReading: reaching out her hand again tonight
findings.explanation: The source withholds the exact renewed action; mirror moon supplies energy collection as established fact.

findings.highlight: She heads eastit seems
findings.evidenceJa: その方角は東
findings.governingReading: she heads east; it seems
findings.explanation: A missing boundary visibly fuses “east” and “it.”

findings.highlight: almost break my mind
findings.evidenceJa: 意識が割れかける
findings.governingReading: his awareness nearly fragments
findings.explanation: A threatened disruption of consciousness is rendered as the unnatural and more extreme “break my mind.”

findings.highlight: The discomfort and the dizziness
findings.evidenceJa: 軽い目眩と、喉元の不快感
findings.governingReading: slight dizziness and discomfort at the throat
findings.explanation: The degree and bodily location of the symptoms disappear.

findings.highlight: Stand Tohsaka and Archer, with their backs to us
findings.evidenceJa: 俺たちに背を向けた状態でいる遠坂たち
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka and Archer stand with their backs toward Shirou and Saber
findings.explanation: An inverted literal structure produces a visibly malformed English sentence.

findings.highlight: that old manMatou Zouken
findings.evidenceJa: あの老人間桐臓硯
findings.governingReading: that old man, Matou Zouken
findings.explanation: A missing boundary fuses the apposition to “man.”

findings.highlight: around Tohsaka
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の足元には
findings.governingReading: at Tohsaka’s feet
findings.explanation: The precise ground location of the small objects becomes a broad area around her.

findings.highlight: used those things to attack them
findings.evidenceJa: 何らかの魔術を用いて二人に仕掛けた
findings.governingReading: used some form of Magecraft to set those things upon the pair
findings.explanation: The explicit Magecraft mechanism and tentative classification disappear.

findings.highlight: beat a confession out of you
findings.evidenceJa: アンタを押さえつけて白状させる
findings.governingReading: pin Zouken down and force him to confess
findings.explanation: Physical restraint and compelled admission become an unsupported beating.

findings.highlight: Harshly scolding me.
findings.evidenceJa: その背中で
findings.governingReading: her turned back nevertheless seems to crackle with complaints at Shirou
findings.explanation: The narrated conceit is broken into sentence fragments that make Rin’s back itself “harshly scolding.”

findings.highlight: Just as how Tohsaka does not look away
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂が間桐臓硯から目を離さないように
findings.governingReading: just as Tohsaka never takes her eyes off Zouken
findings.explanation: The redundant “just as how” construction is ungrammatical.

findings.highlight: Someone we already defeated
findings.evidenceJa: 倒したはずのモノ
findings.governingReading: the thing they believed they had defeated
findings.explanation: An intentionally objectifying and uncertain referent is prematurely humanized as “someone.”

findings.highlight: so she really is still alive
findings.evidenceJa: 本当にまだ残っていやがったのか
findings.governingReading: so she really did remain after all
findings.explanation: Shirou’s shocked recognition of persistence is promoted into literal biological life immediately before Saber identifies a supplemented corpse.

findings.highlight: Her appearance and abilities are the same
findings.evidenceJa: 外装、能力はそのまま
findings.governingReading: the exterior shell and abilities remain intact
findings.explanation: The technical exterior or shell is reduced to visual appearance.

findings.highlight: I do not feel her will or her soul
findings.evidenceJa: 意思である魂を感じない
findings.governingReading: Saber senses no soul, the seat or substance of volition
findings.explanation: A single appositional relation is split into two independently absent things.

findings.highlight: an imitation made from Caster’s corpse
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターの死骸を別のもので補っただけ
findings.governingReading: merely Caster’s corpse supplemented with something else
findings.explanation: The mechanism of another substance filling out the corpse disappears, weakening the later distinction between shell, ability, and soul.

findings.highlight: Shinji’s Rider
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二程度のライダー
findings.governingReading: a Rider of Shinji’s paltry level
findings.explanation: Zouken’s disparaging calibration of Rider and Shinji disappears.

findings.highlight: make you, rather than this corpse, into my slave
findings.evidenceJa: おぬしを屈服させるが最上じゃ
findings.governingReading: the finest outcome is to force Saber into submission rather than use this corpse
findings.explanation: The mature branch changes forced submission into the more specific status of slavery.

findings.highlight: let my worms eat you alive
findings.evidenceJa: その体を我が蟲どもに食わせ
findings.governingReading: feed Saber’s body to Zouken’s worms
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds that the threatened consumption will occur while Saber is alive.

findings.highlight: Then is it not for your sake to turn you into a mindless puppet!?
findings.evidenceJa: 心ない人形と化すがうぬらの為であろう
findings.governingReading: would becoming mindless dolls not be for the Servants’ own benefit?
findings.explanation: The rhetorical provocation is rendered in a malformed infinitive construction.

findings.highlight: Caster’s magic
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターの魔術
findings.governingReading: Caster’s Magecraft
findings.explanation: The setting-specific discipline is again generalized into magic.

findings.highlight: Caster’s body begins to disintegrate
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターの外装が崩れていく
findings.governingReading: Caster’s exterior shell begins to collapse
findings.explanation: The manipulated external shell is again recast as Caster’s actual body.

findings.highlight: To ensure that her body will not be violated again.
findings.evidenceJa: 地上の魔術師に、その亡骸を冒涜される事などないように
findings.governingReading: so that no magus remaining on earth can desecrate her remains
findings.explanation: The living terrestrial magus as agent and the contrast with Caster’s return disappear.

findings.highlight: blood and entrails are spilling from his bisected body
findings.evidenceJa: 何かをみだらに零しながら
findings.governingReading: spilling something indecently or obscenely
findings.explanation: The mature branch specifies blood, entrails, and a bisected body where the source deliberately leaves the emitted matter unidentified.

findings.highlight: He crawls across the ground with his arms, trying to get away from Archer.
findings.evidenceJa: 這っていた
findings.governingReading: the lower-body-less old man crawls
findings.explanation: The mature branch inserts arm propulsion and a deliberate attempt to escape Archer.

findings.highlight: spewing something obscene
findings.evidenceJa: 何かをみだらに零しながら
findings.governingReading: spilling something in an indecent or grotesque manner
findings.explanation: An adverb describing the manner of spilling is attached to the unidentified substance as an inherent property.

findings.highlight: his head is crushedand he is almost dead
findings.evidenceJa: 頭を潰されれば息絶えるだろうし既に
findings.governingReading: if his head is crushed he will die, and already
findings.explanation: A missing boundary visibly fuses “crushed” and “and.”

findings.highlight: My body understands it instinctively, yet it refuses to move.
findings.evidenceJa: 逃げようという命令を体が拒否している
findings.governingReading: his body rejects the command to flee despite understanding the danger before his mind does
findings.explanation: The paradox of a body both issuing and rejecting flight is reduced to generic immobility.

findings.highlight: My body knows that I can’t escape.
findings.evidenceJa: 出会ってしまったからには決して逃れられない
findings.governingReading: once he has encountered it, escape is absolutely impossible
findings.explanation: The triggering condition and categorical permanence of inescapability disappear.

findings.highlight: Why do I find it so familiar?
findings.evidenceJa: 懐かしいとさえ、思ってしまった
findings.governingReading: why he finds himself feeling even nostalgia toward it
findings.explanation: The stronger, temporally charged and disturbing emotion of nostalgia becomes ordinary familiarity.

findings.highlight: Fear of the shadow drove him.
findings.evidenceJa: 死にゆく体に鞭を打った
findings.governingReading: he whips his dying body onward solely through fear of the ominous shadow
findings.explanation: The violent exertion imposed on Zouken’s failing body is compressed into abstract motivation.

findings.highlight: I frantically push Tohsaka aside.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂を弾き飛ばしていた
findings.governingReading: Shirou knocks Rin flying clear
findings.explanation: The force and resulting displacement of Shirou’s rescue are weakened to a push.

findings.highlight: Water has come crashing in around me
findings.evidenceJa: ダンプカーみたいにつっこんできたのは水流
findings.governingReading: the thing that crashed into him like a dump truck was a torrent
findings.explanation: The dump-truck impact and identification of the attacking flow disappear.

findings.highlight: I am now sinking into the sea.
findings.evidenceJa: 頭から呑みこまれた自分は、いま深海にいる
findings.governingReading: engulfed headfirst, he now feels himself in the deep sea
findings.explanation: Being swallowed headfirst and already submerged in a deep-sea state becomes ongoing ordinary sinking.

findings.highlight: cuts off my life
findings.evidenceJa: 生命活動を根こそぎ遮断させていく
findings.governingReading: cuts off every life-sustaining process at the root
findings.explanation: A progressive shutdown of bodily life functions becomes a blunt statement that life itself is cut off.
